lines: If you see this in a house... don't sign anything.
And the last one costs the most money... and almost nobody checks it.
One. Diagonal cracks at the corners of doors and windows.
That's not the paint... it could be the structure.
Two. One single wall with fresh paint.
Three. Turn on the sink and the shower at the same time.
If the water pressure drops, there's a problem with the pipes.
Four. Bring your phone charger and test the outlets.
If one doesn't charge, the wiring is going to cost you.
And five... the one almost nobody checks: the paperwork.
Make sure the house is in the seller's name, with no liens or unpaid debts.
Because a beautiful house with bad paperwork... isn't yours.
We check all of this before we ever show you a house.
Save this video for your next home tour... and send it to someone who's house hunting.
